_comment: Illustrative Slack `/add` slash-command payload delivered over Socket Mode (Phase 9 / ADR 0012). The handler reads `text` (the title), `channel_id` (where to post the completion ping), and `user_id` (for the @mention). `response_url` is deliberately NOT used — it expires ~30 min / 5 uses, and a run can sit in HITL for days; completions go via chat_postMessage instead.
